binding_rule: JSON labels such as fresh/complete/coverage are provider assertions, not implementation evidence. The hardware entry point remains absent until exact implementations, source proofs and independent reviews are bound and checked before construction of a port.

required: Fresh coordinator grant naming this operator, UID, accepted firmware base, exact APP packet, namespace and time window
Accepted advisory lock and TIOCEXCL; no concurrent UI/serial/SD operator
Only the granted APP transaction; no Flash, reset, bootloader, firmware installation or publication
exclusive_lease.gap: No lease granted. Pico queue is CURRENTALL SD, cold-RAM cause/fix, USB/preservation, M0 memory, mathematics, then ELITE/INTERP.

required: First complete unmodified status frame and entire received exchange saved before follow-up
Observed identity, boot counter, firmware CRC/extent, idle command mode, current IP/RTC_SET/settings and health; no historical defaults
Observed largest free allocator block sufficient for 20396-byte APP plus alignment and actual live loader allocations
Exact accepted source/ELF/ABI, core/privilege, divider and INTERP ownership proof for that firmware base
post_cold_anchor.gap: A748 is the immutable arithmetic reference. The post-fix accepted base is not yet known; its addresses and ownership must not be inferred from A748.

methods: capture_full(wire) -> coverage, fresh, uid, build, data bytes
required: Source-proven atomic capture before any APP loader, graph reset, handler/mode change or other destructive bootstrap
Every register bank, stack/LAST X, program, bank map, return stack, input flags, handlers, IP, terminal and UI context
All referenced storage and pointer ownership, relevant live call stack, allocation lifetimes, entry/bootstrap and return/postlude must be preserved
Persist original bytes and digest before mutation; independently verify semantic restoration without a later destructive mode change
No substitution of reg/stk/hout/dump/IP or a synthetic test provider
full_calculator_provider.gap: CALCAP and opaque full-capsule helper dependency withdrawn by explicit human request; no replacement generic preservation project.

methods: capture_all_sd(wire) -> fresh complete anchor with UID/build and hidden/large coverage
required: Fresh complete current tree and every original file byte including hidden/large files, canonical paths and FAT metadata
Source-proven APP-only capture/verification preserving calculator and environment through helper bootstrap and return
Only proven-absent /INTRP01, exact owned-object cleanup and no recursive removal
Existing Reader.install backup guards remain intact; no relabelled historical snapshots or partial inventory equality
all_sd_provider.gap: The coordinator's fresh SD verifier uses a restricted quiet-boot admission. It is not a generic arbitrary-state preservation provider for this adapter.

required: Preserve all settings, all alarms, current directory, RTC_SET and calibrated RTC trajectory across actual wall elapsed time
Observe and retain the original clock/calibration state; never apply a historical date or turn RTC_SET=0 into 1 through date
Final verification after full calculator restoration must not alter its handlers or mode
Capture/restore/readback source proofs and independent review for the exact accepted firmware base
environment_provider.gap: No complete implementation is bound. Mock equality in fault tests is not physical environment restoration evidence.

unreturned_app.behavior: Adapter V2 pump is always receive-only with screen-packet send disabled, including after a valid asynchronous CAPS packet changes attached. Preserve raw binary RX. No status query, ESC, command, keepalive or cleanup while no fresh return prompt exists.
unreturned_app.failure: HOLD with original snapshot, transcript, owned ledger and pending restoration; close serial and refer recovery to coordinator. No restored-state or completed-benchmark claim.
unreturned_app.gap: The actual hardware recovery procedure must be assigned by the coordinator for the accepted firmware. This offline adapter does not improvise one.

after_base_change: Keep mathematical packet-v2 immutable as A748 reference
Review the exact new source, ELF, loader, ABI, privilege, INTERP/divider clients and allocation headroom
Bind the newly reviewed preservation providers and exclusive lease
Only then prepare a separately identified hardware execution packet

current_dependency_scope.operator_responsibility: Preserve and restore data actually affected by a future concrete test; this does not authorize execution now.
